# Committee Changes Register
Quillbrook Village Hall is a fictional organisation.

## 1. How to use this register
1.1 These entries replace only the named governing sections.
1.2 All other governing wording remains unchanged.
1.3 The original governing documents retain their adopted wording.
1.4 Entries apply from their effective dates, not their decision dates.

## 2. Decision made 18 September 2025
2.1 Effective 1 November 2025: replace hall-fees.md section 2.1.
2.2 Main Hall hire is £28 per hour instead of £24.
2.3 Controlling date: the first date of the booked event.

## 3. Decision made 15 January 2026
3.1 Effective 1 February 2026: replace hall-fees.md section 3.1.
3.2 Registered village groups receive 25% off room hire instead of 20%.
3.3 Controlling date: the first date of the booked event.

## 4. Decision made 15 January 2026
4.1 Effective 1 March 2026: replace hall-bookings.md section 3.1.
4.2 Monday to Thursday opening hours become 08:00 to 21:30.
4.3 Controlling date: the date on which room use takes place.

## 5. Decision made 20 March 2026
5.1 Effective 1 April 2026: replace hall-conduct.md section 4.1.
5.2 Friday and Saturday amplified music must stop by 21:30.
5.3 Controlling date: the date on which the music is played.

## 6. Decision made 14 May 2026
6.1 Effective 1 June 2026: replace hall-refunds.md section 2.2.
6.2 Cancellation from 14 to 27 days before the event gives a 25% refund.
6.3 Controlling date: when the booking officer receives cancellation.
6.4 The separate booking deposit exclusion still applies.

## 7. Decision made 14 May 2026
7.1 Effective 1 July 2026: replace hall-safety.md section 5.1.
7.2 The chair may authorise up to £650 for urgent safety work.
7.3 Controlling date: when the emergency spending is authorised.

## 4. Room capacities
4.1 Main Hall: maximum 90 people.
4.2 Meeting Room: maximum 24 people.
4.3 Combined events may not exceed 100 people in the building.
4.4 Capacities include organisers, performers and children.
4.5 Fire safety requirements in hall-safety.md also apply.

## 5. Access and equipment

content.text:
No, the combined event is not permitted. It would be 112 people in the building, which is 12 over the 100-person limit for combined events (hall-bookings.md, section 4.3).

The 89 in the Main Hall and 23 in the Meeting Room are each within their own limits of 90 and 24 (hall-bookings.md, sections 4.1 and 4.2). Those limits would otherwise apply on their own. Section 4.3 sets the building-wide cap for combined events, and section 4.4 counts organisers, performers and children toward it.

hall-changes.md does not replace section 4, so the 12 October 2025 date makes no difference to this answer.
